panel_description_zh: 中近景平视，妻子快步走回客厅，手里还提着那袋零食；脸上更怀疑了；她的视线扫向沙发方向（李斌在那里）；头发是低马尾（随走动晃动）。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 那一定是在窗帘后面，要不就是在阳台。不行，我得去找找，我看家里是不是真藏人了？

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium close-up in the living room of a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman walking back into the room with the translucent plastic snack bag in one hand, the other hand gesturing forward. Yoga-class-returned outfit: sage green zip-up jacket, charcoal grey leggings, white sneakers. Face shown in three-quarter side view, the scowl deepened by frustration, eyebrows drawn down and inward at the bridge in a tighter scowl than before, eyes narrowed scanning toward the off-frame sofa direction, mouth slightly open mid-scolding. Long straight black hair is the low ponytail with strands framing the face. Single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline, fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the gesturing hand. Warm yellow-white living room light. Mood: the suspicion now includes '那一定是在窗帘后面，要不就是在阳台。不行，我得去找找，我看家里是不是真藏人了？' — the marital surveillance taken to its absurd end. Text watermark 'P12-PN05' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in the room, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, bloodshot eyes, romantic soft lighting, decorative items like a clock or wall art
